title: The Thornway
truth: The cart track narrows to a deer path within sight of the village and runs on into close-grown thorn and birch.
Wool tufts snagged on the thorns mark the flock's route north in a line no shepherd would have chosen.
The path forks: the wider way continues along the old drove road, and a narrower cut breaks off through the thorn towards higher ground.
consequences: Following the wool tufts rather than the drove road adds an hour to the walk but keeps the true trail; losing it means backtracking to the fork.

hidden.fact: The narrower cut has been deliberately widened at ankle height, as if something has dragged heavy loads through it more than once.
hidden.discovered_by: a Wisdom (Perception) check while walking the narrower cut, or crouching to examine the broken thorn at ground level

exits.description: The narrow cut, climbing towards a rocky outcrop where the thorn finally gives way to bare stone.
exits.condition: the player has followed the wool-marked trail rather than the open drove road
